summary:
The code does what the design asks. ScanStore puts the mark in bit 0x80 of the existing Flags byte. Append sets it on folders before the count is published (ScanStore.cs:261), SetChildren clears it for any count (:296), and Append and AddFlags throw on a caller's 0x80 before any write (:248, :307). Flags() masks the bit (:103), and NotListed(int) is the new public read (:118). Only four places write the flags byte, all in ScanStore.cs, and the only callers of SetChildren are FolderDone and StoreSkipped. Scanner.ListRoot now appends the root right after the directory check (Scanner.cs:261). That leaves rootEntry's meaning, Execute's branches and TopLevelTracker.Seed as they were. App consumers (ShowOutcome, WindowReport, LargestFiles, KindBreakdown) cope with a store holding only the root.

What I ran:
- Full suite: 984 passed, 0 failed, 37.7 s.
- The no-edits check `git diff --diff-filter=M --name-only $(git merge-base HEAD uat) -- tests` printed nothing (merge-base 6ce263e).
- My own mutant, SetChildren clearing the mark only when childCount > 0, made 9 NotListed tests fail, including AnEmptyFolderListedBeforeTheStopReadsListed and the sweep in both modes. The file was restored and hash-checked.
- SL-109-NotListedBitRule.Tests.ps1: all checks held.
- RuleCases -Case C-001 and -Case C-003: all held, AGREE 18 facts, 75 and 76 settled.
- harness.py --scenario all under the engine's venv: 167 rows, 167 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray hits.
- Fitness: 97 rules hold.

I read each matrix test and checked that it really feeds its shape in. The sweep stops before and during every guarded call of a tree with a multi-buffer folder, a denied folder, a hardlink pair, a junction and a planted store, and compares the mark with the AfterFolder record of the same run. The cut-folder test asserts that big spans more than one buffer. The root test sweeps every call of a 2,000-entry root. The empty-vs-unread test compares every other read field by field. The sizing stop cancels inside the Probe seam. The twin and recount tests run at five named stop points. The listed-ahead case (material: false) is still unproducible: the walk is single-threaded and depth-first.

Two findings:
- Criterion 7's app half is still unmeasured. Critique M1 is recorded accepted-fixed, but the design was never changed to match (filed_for_later #2 is still there). The builder declared this honestly, so it needs a person or design decision, not a rebuild.
- The rule-1 corpus, which the build says closes the spelling class, misses a using-alias type, an @-prefixed type name, `global ::` with spaces, and the complement mask `& ~0x7F`. None of these is a fire or residual row.

Second round: Round 2 found nothing new; round 1's two findings (M1, the unmeasured app half of criterion 7, and m1, the rule-1 spelling gaps) still stand and are not refiled.

Product boundaries:
- **Flags byte writers.** Every write is still in ScanStore.cs (:261, :281, :296, :310). Append checks 0x80 before CheckParent and before any column is written. AddFlags checks HardlinkDuplicate first, then 0x80. Flags() masks with an int complement, and the result stays within the byte enum.
- **ListRoot early append.** Error paths that now end with the root in the store:
  - aborted DecideLastAccess queries, an aborted or failed keep reopen, and an aborted listing with Count zeroed all leave a one-entry store, Cancelled or RootUnreadable;
  - a listing that fails part-way with entries kept commits through FolderDone, so the root reads listed and Unreadable;
  - an empty root reads listed.
- **Consumers of a root-only store.** ShowOutcome, WindowReport, LargestFiles, KindBreakdown, UnreadableRows and an unseeded TopLevelTracker read nothing that assumed Count 0. WindowReport writes no store count, and no test under tests/bugs or tests/window (outside the solution, so the suite never runs them) asserts Count 0 or RootUnreadable store contents.

Parsers and matchers:
- **Read-Patterns** in SL-109-NotListedBitRule.Tests.ps1 fails loudly on every malformed input:
  - CRLF is stripped by ReadAllLines;
  - a double-quoted pattern throws;
  - a blank or comment line, or an unclosed multi-line single-quoted scalar, drops or garbles a pattern, and each fire family needs all four patterns, so fire rows go red.
- **Line breaks in the patterns.** Tabs, CRLF, a lone CR and U+2028 between the cast and the literal are covered by `\s` in both .NET and Python re.
- **Rule 2's `$` on CRLF** is absorbed by `\s*`. Its other misses belong to m2, which was overridden.
- **The Python stdin pipe** carries ASCII only, so no encoding loss.

Remaining exotic misses, below the bar for an accidental-threat family and not filed: `(EntryFlags)0_128`, and UTF-16 source files that Fitness cannot read (lesson #440).

findings.claim: Criterion 7 promises that the app stays within 1 GiB at a 5M-entry store stopped at its unlisted peak. Nothing in the tree measures the app. NotListedBudgetTests records only the Core test host's private commit (690.0 MiB). The design record states that the app figure is a composed bound: 690.0 MiB plus the idle published window's 64.9 MiB, about 755 MiB. Critique M1 is recorded 'accepted-fixed', meaning the design was to add a case that drives the real App through FsaWindowHook. The design handed to build was never changed: it still carries that measurement under filed_for_later, and the disposition's own assumption, that the hook can reach that state unattended, is false. The builder declared this and built the earlier version. Validate will meet a done criterion half unmeasured, under a ledger entry that says it was fixed. This is not a builder defect, and rebuilding will not fix it.
findings.evidence: tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/NotListedBudgetTests.cs:20-22 (test-host commit, 'the app itself is not driven here'); docs/design/SL-109-not-listed.md:73-78; the design's filed_for_later #2 vs the M1 disposition 'accepted-fixed ... filed_for_later #2 is withdrawn'

quote.text: **The app half of criterion 7 is not measured as such.**

findings.fix: Route this to a person or to design-slice, not to build. Choose one: (a) reword criterion 7's app half to the composed bound (test-host commit at the stop plus the published window's measured idle commit, against 1 GiB) and re-dispose M1 to match; or (b) mark the app half deferred to the FsaWindowHook synthetic-store slice already in follow_ups, so validate records it as not reached rather than met.

findings.claim:
Rule 1 ('no code outside the store spells the not-listed bit as an entry flag') is declared closed as a class through a 97-row corpus. The corpus misses several spellings of the same always-false test, and none of them is a fire or residual row:
- a using-alias type: `using NL = FsAnalyser.Core.Store.EntryFlags;` then `(NL)0x80`
- an @-prefixed type name: `(@EntryFlags)0x80`
- `global ::` with spaces: `(global :: FsAnalyser.Core.Store.EntryFlags)0x80`
- the complement mask `((byte)store.Flags(e) & ~0x7F) != 0`, and the same with `~127`
I checked each against the four patterns read from .taad/fitness.yaml: 0 hits for every one. Using alias and @identifier are both on this project's own text-rule spelling checklist (lesson #446). The complement mask ('any bit beyond the named ones') is a natural way for a later view to write the test.
findings.evidence: tests/bugs/SL-109-NotListedBitRuleCorpus.json bounded_by and rows C01-C35, M01-M16, X01-X10; the .taad/fitness.yaml rule 1 patterns (type-name piece `(?:global::)?(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*\.\s*)*EntryFlags`, and a mask piece that allows no `~`)

quote.text: that is the operand of a cast to EntryFlags (a qualified or global:: type name, parentheses or an inner numeric cast between)

findings.fix:
Add these rows to tests/bugs/SL-109-NotListedBitRuleCorpus.json:
- `var mark = (@EntryFlags)0x80;`
- `var mark = (global :: FsAnalyser.Core.Store.EntryFlags)0x80;`
- `using NL = FsAnalyser.Core.Store.EntryFlags;` + `var mark = (NL)0x80;`
- `bool unread = ((byte)store.Flags(e) & ~0x7F) != 0;`
- `bool unread = ((byte)store.Flags(e) & ~127) != 0;`
Then either make them fire or record them as residual and name them in bounded_by and in the rule's because. To make them fire: allow `@?` and `global\s*::\s*` in the type-name piece; add a pattern for `&=?\s*~\s*(?:0[xX]0*7[fF]|0*127|0[bB]0*1{7})`; and forbid a using alias of EntryFlags in src outside the store, e.g. `\busing\s+@?\w+\s*=\s*[\w.:\s]*EntryFlags\s*;`.
findings.class_of: spellings of a test of the not-listed bit outside the store

obligations.evidence: tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/NotListedTests.cs:120-210. Stops before and during every guarded call of SweepTree. A folder's expected mark is (folder && not in the run's own AfterFolder list), and that list must equal the baseline's call-number prefix. Queued folders were met (the notListedFolders > Calls assert). Green in my run.

NotListedTests.cs:217-263. Every call from big's open to its end-of-listing, both modes. Asserts buffers > 1, big NotListed with ChildCount 0 and FirstChild -1, z NotListed, and Count == 5. The sweep also counts cutInsideBig >= bigBuffers.

NotListedTests.cs:318-354. Every call of a 2,000-entry root (open, attributes, DecideLastAccess queries, keep reopen, every buffer), both modes. For k > 2: Count 1, NotListed(0), no children, Rolled 0, Cancelled, RootError 0. Backed by Scanner.cs:261 (AppendRoot after the directory check).

NotListedTests.cs:360-388. Calls 1-2 in both modes, a pre-cancelled token and a file root (RootUnreadable 267) all give Count 0. RootTests and CancellationTests are unedited and green (git diff --diff-filter=M empty).

NotListedTests.cs:267-309. AfterFolder stops after 2 and after 3 folders, plus a completed run. a-empty reads listed; b, z and b\c read not listed. Kind, Flags, FirstChild, ChildCount, Rolled and ChildrenLargestFirst are compared field by field. My count-0 SetChildren mutant made this test fail.
NotListedTests.cs:396-428. The Probe seam cancels on the first probe. Asserts Cancelled, Probes 0, 5 folders, and no entry NotListed.

NotListedTests.cs:442-488. Append throws for folder, file and link, with 0x80 alone and with each named flag, and Count is unchanged. AddFlags throws on a marked folder, a listed folder, a file, a link and the root, with neither the mark nor the named flag applied. Code: ScanStore.cs:248-249, 307-308.
NotListedTests.cs:490-515, Theory over 0 and 3 children (files and folders mixed). The folder stays marked during the child appends; SetChildren clears it. ScanStore.cs:296.

NotListedTests.cs:517-571. AddFlags of each named flag on a marked folder, a listed folder, a file and a link; named flags passed to Append on folders; a hardlink duplicate; CorrectSizes under a chain of marked folders.

NotListedTests.cs:576-649. Five StopPoints. RollupOracle.Expected/AssertMatches run over a Fed stream built from the raw Parent/Kind/Size/OnDisk/FileId columns, plus CheckStructure, AssertChargedBytesAreTheTotals and ChildrenLargestFirst against an independent sort.

NotListedTests.cs:651-720. A twin replayed through RollupOracle.Feed (childless folders registered, Unreadable added afterwards) is compared on Kind, Flags, charged bytes, Rolled, children and order. Enum.GetValues/GetNames are checked for 0x80. The just-after-m stop holds denied (Unreadable), Layers (NotScanned), h2 (HardlinkDuplicate) and z (queued). CancelledFolderTests is unedited and green.

NotListedTests.cs:724-755. Completed sweep tree, plus a tree with a junction and a path over 260 characters. No entry NotListed, and no Flags carries 0x80. Full suite 984/984 with no modified test file.

NotListedBudgetTests.cs:37-142, in the MemoryBudget collection. Scanner-order generator stopped right after W's 60,000 subfolders. Asserts marked == 60,000 == pending stack, retained and peak < 800 MiB, root totals equal the generator's, and test-host commit < 1 GiB. Green in my run. The app's own commit is not measured; see finding M1.

My own read; the obligation is owed to validate. Every write to the flags byte in src is in ScanStore.cs: :261 (Append, folder gets the bit), :281 (HardlinkDuplicate OR, files only), :296 (SetChildren clears), :310 (AddFlags OR, after the 0x80 refusal at :307). CorrectSizes does not touch Flags. SetChildren's only callers are Scanner.cs:346 (StoreSkipped) and :387 (FolderDone), both whole registrations. Rule 1 fences src outside the store, with the spelling gaps in finding m1.

.taad/fitness.yaml rule 1 has four patterns, and tests/bugs/SL-109-NotListedBitRuleCorpus.json (97 rows) is run by SL-109-NotListedBitRule.Tests.ps1, which passed in my run. The class is not fully closed: see finding m1 (using alias, @identifier, `global ::` spacing, ~0x7F mask).

I re-ran all three on this tree. RuleCases -Case C-001 and -Case C-003: all checks held. harness.py --scenario all (engine venv): 167/167 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray hits. Listed under docs/design/SL-109-not-listed.md:95-97.

Waived to SC-368. The invariant sentence is still present in ScanStore.cs:287-290 (SetChildren doc: 'the whole of them, in one call') and in docs/design/SL-109-not-listed.md:29-31 (block-wise writers; RollupOracle.Feed is not to be copied).
docs/design/SL-109-not-listed.md:92-94 uses the merge-base form. I ran it: empty output, merge-base 6ce263e.

Waived to SC-369, but present: NotListedBudgetTests.cs:145-154 collects twice (Aggressive, blocking, compacting) and records GC TotalCommittedBytes. The remarks at :18-19 state the generator holds no per-entry state.

Waived to SC-370. No Fact pins the RootUnreadable one-entry result: a root whose first List fails with a non-cancel error, or whose keep reopen fails. Scanner.cs:261 with :272-273 and :286-287 produces it.

cases.evidence: NotListedTests.CancelAtAnyCallMarksExactlyTheFoldersNotCommitted. Stops before and during every scan-thread call. Queued folders (deep\inner, h1, h2, m, z after earlier commits) are checked against the AfterFolder record; notListedFolders > Calls proves they were met.
AFolderCutPartwayThroughItsBuffersReadsNotListed: 2,000 names of 100 characters, asserts buffers > 1, stops at every buffer call before and during. The sweep also asserts cutInsideBig >= bigBuffers.
AStopInTheRootsListingLeavesTheRootNotListed: 2,000-entry root on local NTFS (keep path taken), every call k > 2 including the DecideLastAccess queries and the keep reopen, both modes.
ARootNotYetKnownToBeAFolderLeavesNoRootToMark: k = 1, 2 in both modes, a pre-cancelled token, and a file root (267), each asserting Count 0.
AnEmptyFolderListedBeforeTheStopReadsListed builds a-empty, b\c\f.bin and z\g.bin exactly, stops after 2 and after 3 via AfterFolder, then completes. My count-0 SetChildren mutant made it fail.
AStopDuringSizingLeavesEveryFolderListed: the Probe seam calls cts.Cancel() inside the first probe; asserts probed > 0, Cancelled, Probes 0, no entry NotListed.
ACallerCannotSetTheMark (Theory over Folder, File, Link; 0x80 alone and with each named flag) and ACallerCannotSetTheMarkThroughAddFlags (marked folder, listed folder, file, link, root).

AMarkedFolderTakesItsChildrenAndSetChildrenClearsIt(0, 3): children are appended under the still-marked folder before SetChildren, and the mark is asserted still set before SetChildren and clear after.

EveryOtherFlagWriteLeavesTheMarkAlone: AddFlags of every named flag except HardlinkDuplicate on marked and listed folders, a file and a link; CorrectSizes on a file under a chain a/b/c of marked folders; file, link and hardlink appends.

AStoppedStoreRecountsWithNoDifference at five StopPoints: inside big before and during, h2's open, the root's last buffer during, z's open after m. A recount from raw columns via RollupOracle.Expected.

AStoppedStoreClassifiesAsItsMaskedTwin: the extra afterM stop asserts that denied is Unreadable and listed, Layers is NotScanned and listed, h2 is HardlinkDuplicate, and z is queued, all in one store; twin comparison at all five points.

ACompletedScanLeavesNothingNotListed: the sweep tree (Unreadable, NotScanned, junction, hardlink) plus a tree asserting a path over 260 characters and a Link entry. Full suite 984/984; the no-edits diff is empty.

NotListedBudgetTests.AStoreStoppedAtItsUnlistedPeakFitsTheBudget stops right after W's 60,000-subfolder block and asserts marked == 60,000 == pending. The store half is exercised; the app's commit is not (finding M1).

Marked material: false in the design, with no test. The reason still holds against this tree: Execute is a single-threaded pop/Read/FolderDone loop over _pending (Scanner.cs:208-229), DirectoryReader lists one folder at a time, and only SetChildren clears the mark.

drift: No undeclared departure was found. Every difference between code and design is one the builder listed under deviations: the M1 app-commit case not built, rule 1 widened, a junction added to the sweep tree, the generator shape, and two extra Facts.

The design export still carries 'measure the published WPF app's own commit' under filed_for_later, while critique M1's disposition is recorded 'accepted-fixed', which said that item was withdrawn. The design record and the disposition disagree. The code follows the design record.

Minor inconsistency in the slice's own wording: the NotListedBudgetTests remarks (lines 20-22) use U-001's ~106 MB window baseline, while docs/design/SL-109-not-listed.md:70 records the published window's measured idle commit as 64.9 MiB and composes the bound from that.
Nothing new beyond round 1: every departure was declared by the builder.
